Routines

top source crisp::extractstates_nondb

CRISP pipeline

crisp::extractstates_nondb, strings [, states] [, /force] [, /polcal] [, /strip_settings]

Extract states information from an array of strings (typically file names).

Replaces the various versions of red_getstates. Based on regular expressions and vectorization.

Parameters

strings in type=strarr

A list of strings from which to extract the states information.

states out optional type=array(struct)

An array of structs, containing (partially filled) state information.

Keywords

force in optional type=boolean

Do not use cached states.

polcal in optional type=boolean

Set this to add polcal-specific items in the states, qw and lp.

strip_settings in optional type=boolean

Exclude exposure/gain information from the fullstate entries.

Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl, ISP

History:

2018-04-16 : MGL. Make old-style CRISP files a special case, working more like in the old code base.

2019-07-22 : OA. Renamed to crisp::exctractstates_nodb, from now on crisp::extractstates is a wrapper around db and nondb versions.

2026-06-03 : MGL. Allow 2d input array.
